analyzed_vuln.description: In decode_R13_R2000, header variable decoding is invoked without bounding the Bit_Chain to the declared header-vars payload length. After reading dwg->header_vars.size, the code calls dwg_decode_header_variables(dat, ...) while dat->size still reflects the whole file, so malformed/truncated header data can drive bit readers past the actual header-vars buffer. This unsafe state propagation leads to an out-of-bounds read in bit_read_BB (via bit_read_BD).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: From llvmfuzz, attacker-controlled DWG bytes set up a valid-enough R13/R2000 header section so decode_R13_R2000 reaches section 0 parsing. The header-vars stream then contains insufficient bits for expected FIELD_BD reads (e.g., around header_variables.spec FIELD_BD entries), but because decoding is not limited to header_vars.size/end position, parsing continues and bit_read_BB reads at/after the end of the fuzz input allocation, triggering ASan heap-buffer-overflow.
